# show

One changeset in full: its parents, author, message, changes and signatures; pass max\_changes of 100 or less, since clients limit long tool results.

```yaml
title: "show"
description: "Show a changeset."
since: "0.1.0"
mutates: false
identity_required: false
cli_command: "swarmops show"
envelope_op: "show"
request_type: "ShowReq"
annotations: {"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":false,"readOnlyHint":true}
max_result_chars: null
```

## Input schema

`arguments` is a `ShowReq`: `swarmops schema ShowReq` prints the type. A field the type does not know is ignored.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max_changes` | integer | no | `400` | The most entries of `changes` to return: at least 1 (0 is `E_INVALID_ARG`). |
| `rev` | string | yes |  | The changeset to show. A revision as the caller wrote it, for the store to resolve: a ref name (`main`, `release/1.2`), a full 64-hex changeset id or a unique prefix of at least 12 hex digits, optionally followed by `~N` for the N-th first-parent ancestor. |

### JSON Schema

As `tools/list` gives it: each `$ref` replaced by its definition, so that it stands alone.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "description": "`show`: one changeset in full.",
  "properties": {
    "max_changes": {
      "default": 400,
      "description": "The most entries of `changes` to return: at least 1 (0 is `E_INVALID_ARG`).",
      "format": "uint",
      "minimum": 1,
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "rev": {
      "description": "The changeset to show. A revision as the caller wrote it, for the store to resolve: a ref name (`main`,\n`release/1.2`), a full 64-hex changeset id or a unique prefix of at least 12 hex digits,\noptionally followed by `~N` for the N-th first-parent ancestor.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "rev"
  ],
  "title": "ShowReq",
  "type": "object"
}
```

## Annotations

It only reads the store.

| Annotation | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `destructiveHint` | `false` | True: a tool that changes the store may overwrite or delete what is there, not only add to it. |
| `idempotentHint` | `true` | True: calling it again with the same arguments changes nothing more. |
| `openWorldHint` | `false` | True: it reaches beyond a closed set of things. Every tool here stays inside the store. |
| `readOnlyHint` | `true` | True: the tool does not change its environment, the store. |

Its entry in `tools/list` carries no `_meta`.

## CLI command

[`swarmops show`](../commands/show.md) runs the same operation and prints the same envelope.

The server ran as `swarmops mcp --repo [tmp]/store --as agent/worker-17`, after `initialize`. Recorded by the MCP tests. A name in square brackets, such as `[tmp]` or `[c1]`, stands for what differs from run to run: the test's temporary directory, an id, a time, the version.

## Return information

A tool result: the envelope, whose `op` is `show`, as `structuredContent` and again as the text of its one `content` block. `isError` is true exactly when the envelope's `ok` is false. On success the envelope's `result` is what [`swarmops show`](../commands/show.md#return-information) returns.

## Errors

A failed call is a tool result with `isError: true`; the envelope's `error.code` is one of the [error codes](../errors.md).

- [`E_INVALID_ARG`](../errors.md#e_invalid_arg): arguments that do not fit `ShowReq`, a field named twice among them included, or that break one of the server's own rules.
- [`E_NOT_A_REPO`](../errors.md#e_not_a_repo): the server's store is not there; the server serves on.
- [`E_INTERNAL`](../errors.md#e_internal): the operation panicked, a bug.

Then the errors of the operation, as [`swarmops show`](../commands/show.md#errors) lists them.
